item.description:
### Added
- Capture Text shows that it is reading, with Cancel; Esc cancels too. - Capture Previous Text Area: read the same place again without selecting it — subtitles, slide after slide (⌃⌥⌘T). - Join lines into paragraphs: text that wraps on screen comes out one line per paragraph (Settings › Capture). - Custom words: names and terms that text recognition keeps as written (Settings › Capture). - A right click on the menu bar icon can start Capture Text (Settings › Capture).
### Fixed
- Scrolling captures no longer lose or repeat lines on pages that repeat themselves, like a changelog with the same heading in every section. - Scrolling fast no longer leaves half lines or skips part of the page in a scrolling capture. - The editor shows all of a long capture’s recognized text, the side panel scrolling, instead of cutting it off. - Text is recognized on long scrolling captures too, read in pieces. - Capture Text no longer waits without end while macOS prepares text recognition: after a while it says so and asks to try again.
